```{=html}
<script>
// Events filter (hides a year heading when none of its events match)
document.querySelectorAll(".event-filter button").forEach(function (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var f = btn.dataset.filter;
    document.querySelectorAll(".event-filter button").forEach(function (b) {
      b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".event").forEach(function (ev) {
      ev.style.display = (f === "all" || ev.classList.contains(f)) ? "" : "none";
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".year-group").forEach(function (g) {
      var any = Array.prototype.some.call(g.querySelectorAll(".event"), function (ev) {
        return ev.style.display !== "none";
      });
      g.style.display = any ? "" : "none";
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
